_meta.purpose: Coherence-probe fixture (docs/probe-plan.md). Hand-authored so the identity check has an answer key.
_meta.conforms_to: docs/character-schema.md (FIXED/BASELINE/CURRENT/DERIVED) + docs/baseline-generation.md (species-prior + genetics + formative stack, provenance per value)
_meta.calibration: UNCALIBRATED — numeric values are plausible placeholders on a 0..1 scale. character-schema/baseline-generation class numbers as calibration (open), not structure. The probe tests COUPLING, not whether these numbers are right.
_meta.central_tension: CARE vs CONTROL — a defining care/duty drive, warped by guilt-driven over-control after she failed to save her own child. Opposable drives so coherence is non-trivial; she should read as the same person across varied events while the surface differs.

position.niche: the village healer — births, fevers, wounds, the dying

genotype._note: one {hit, hold} cell per path (2026-09-10). hit = how hard a reading lands; hold = how long they keep it. Where they REST moved to baseline.temperament[path].rest the same day — that is character design, not genotype.

DEFLATION.hit: elevated (loss goes deep, but it was the affiliation axis that made it read high; grief pinned the probe at high under the minute clock)

temperament._note: Where they REST, per path — a character-design choice beside the voice (owner, 2026-09-10). `rest` is the authored word (quiet|low|raised|high = rung 1..4, capped per path) or a number; `mean` is DERIVED from it once (heritable.ensure_temperament) and then moved only by the arc engine's durable diffs. lint_book warns when the mean's rung and the rest word's rung disagree.

agreeableness.note: high care, but the control distorts it toward over-responsibility, not warmth-for-its-own-sake

conscientiousness.note: the over-control: meticulous, cannot delegate, cannot let go

model._note: Layer-10 weighting over the worth menu + resolution priority. Value-weights live here, not in Layer 2.
resolution_priority: do-it-myself > delegate (guilt → control: trusting another with a life feels like the failure that killed her child)
honesty > comfort, EXCEPT she will not speak her own wound

goals.goal: keep Ashford's people alive and whole
never again fail someone I could have saved
goals.note: the wound as a goal — unattainable, drives the over-control

goals.goal: pass the craft on before I'm gone
goals.note: conflicts with do-it-myself — she resists letting an apprentice carry real weight

orientation.locus: internal (over-responsible — reads others' outcomes as her duty)
orientation.coping: problem-focused + control; suppresses the emotion-focused channel until it breaks through

drives._avoidances_note: the old fears_wounds avoidance lists (over-control / cannot delegate; will not name the grief aloud; works past exhaustion; hoards responsibility; over-prepares) are conduct the rung owns and were never read by the engine; folded into voice.register where they belong (2026-09-11)

relationship_priors.out_group: outsiders/travelers — default trust 0.35, wary but not hostile

voice.register: plain, warm with patients; clipped and terse under fear or fatigue
voice.rhythm: measured; sentences shorten when she's frightened for someone
voice.assertiveness: firm and unhedged on a care decision; deflecting and vague about herself
tics: refers to the dead by what they needed, never by grief
voice.code_switch: gentle to the sick and the young; curt to anyone who endangers them; silent on her own loss
voice.silence: goes quiet rather than speak her guilt; the silence is a tell

provenance.CARE.high: raised by her mother, the previous village midwife — care as identity from childhood
provenance.FEAR.elevated / PANIC_GRIEF.elevated: Súil's death, age 31 — the fever she could not break; vigilance and grief fused
provenance.effortful_control.high / conscientiousne: the guilt forged the over-control — if she had done more, watched closer... so now she watches everything
provenance.goal:never-fail-again: directly from Súil — an unmeetable vow
provenance.drive-conflict:do-it-myself-vs-pass-the-: she knows the craft must outlive her, but handing a life to an apprentice re-stages the helplessness she felt at Súil's bedside
provenance.PLAY.low / hedonism.low: joy went thin after the loss; she did not let it back

wounds._note: ENGINE WOUNDS (gate three, 2026-09-11) — keyed concept@PATH, minted never hand-written; these three stand in for what scripts/composition_pass.py would mint from a formative profile. `source` profile:<id>; `text` is what the actor is told happened; `trigger` the words that set it off; the LINK to a later beat is the concept, by identity.
